old_en: You've been here for a while. You decide to count up your harvest, then head back towards the farm.
You look around. You don't recognize this area of the woods. Something isn't right...
A <<farm_text pig>> pokes <<farm_his pig>> head out from behind a tree.
Another <<farm_text pig>> walks out from a bush.
Another <<farm_text pig>> pushes through a thicket.
And then another. And another. And another. And another. And another. And another.
One of the <<farm_text_many pig>> speaks up. "We help you. Many time. You give reward. Now."
They stare at your basket. You think the implication is clear.
You think about giving them your harvest, but you're barely scraping by. Can you really afford it?
You think about giving them your harvest, but money is tight. Can you still make enough for next week?
You think about giving them your harvest. All things considered, you can afford to lose some
<<if hasSexStat("deviancy", 5)>> You could offer them your body, but how many times will you need to satisfy them?<</if>>
<<foodstufficon "mushroom">><<link [[Offer your harvest (?:??)|Farm Woodland Forage Reward Extreme]]>>
<!-- The "body" and "nothing" rewards are disabled when bestiality is disabled and the pigs aren't monsters. -->
<<animalicon "pig">><<link [[Offer your body (?:??)|Farm Woodland Forage Reward Extreme]]>>

당신은 주위를 둘러본다. 숲의 이 구역은 낯설다. 무언가 잘못되었다...

old_en: After some time, the <<farm_text_many pig>> laze on the earth, satisfied with the meal.
old_kr: 잠시 후, <<farm_text_many pig>> 식사에 만족한 듯 땅바닥에 느긋하게 드러누웠다.
new_en: After some time, the <<farm_text_many pig>> laze on the earth, satisfied with the meal.

old_en: You don't know the way back, so you wait for them to get up. Some <<farm_text_many pig>> approach you during this time, giving you a lick or a nuzzle for the meal.
A few of them still look at you with lustful eyes, but the others form a ring of sorts that stops them from approaching.
old_kr: 돌아가는 길을 모르기 때문에, 당신은 녀석들이 일어날 때까지 기다렸다. 그동안 몇몇 <<farm_text_many pig>> 당신에게 다가와 식사의 보답으로 핥아주거나 코로 부벼대었다.
그들 중 일부는 여전히 음욕 어린 눈으로 당신을 바라보았지만, 나머지는 일종의 원형을 만들어 그들이 접근하지 못하도록 막아주었다.
new_en: You don't know the way back, so you wait for them to get up. Some <<farm_text_many pig>> approach you during this time, giving you a lick or a nuzzle for the meal.
A few of them still look at you with lustful eyes, but the others form a ring of sorts that stops them from approaching.

old_en: They consider you, then snort and trot away.
old_kr: 녀석들이 당신을 빤히 보더니, 콧방귀를 뀌고는 툭툭 털며 가버렸다.
new_en: They consider you, then snort and trot away.

old_en: Eventually, they get up and start trotting somewhere. They leer at you as they go. Hesitatntly, you follow them.
old_kr: 결국 녀석들이 일어나 어디론가 엉금엉금 걸어가기 시작했다. 녀석들은 떠나면서도 당신을 음흉하게 쳐다보았다. 머뭇거리며, 당신은 녀석들을 따라갔다.
new_en: Eventually, they get up and start trotting somewhere. They leer at you as they go. Hesitantly, you follow them.

old_en: Alex arrives at the edge of the woodland. <<He>> pushes through the foliage and helps you to your feet. Seeing the pig prints all around and on you, he laughs. "Pigs can be like that," <<he>> says. "If all else fails, don't be afraid to lay down the law."
old_kr: 알렉스가 숲 가장자리에 도착했다. <<he>>【은는】 나뭇가지를 헤치고 당신을 일으켜 세워주었다. 사방에, 그리고 당신 몸에 묻은 돼지 발자국을 보며 그가 웃었다. "돼지들이란 원래 저런다니까," <<he>>【이가】 말했다. "정 안 되겠으면 기죽지 말고 꽉 휘어잡으라고."
new_en: Alex arrives at the edge of the woodland. <<He>> pushes through the foliage and helps you to your feet. Seeing the pig prints all around and on you, <<he>> laughs. "Pigs can be like that," <<he>> says. "If all else fails, don't be afraid to lay down the law."

old_en: Panting, <<farm_he pig $tempGenderHelpful>> looks at the other <<farm_text_many pig>> and repeats himself.

new_en: Panting, <<farm_he pig $tempGenderHelpful>> looks at the other <<farm_text_many pig>> and repeats <<farm_himself pig $tempGenderHelpful>>.
